name: Remote files
description: Browse, view and edit files on SFTP, FTPS and FTP servers in Cockpit's file browser. A server's host key or certificate is shown to you and trusted before anything of your login is sent, and a changed key is refused. Passwords and keys are stored as secrets. Each connection is read only until you allow writing. On a Cockpit server, the connection runs from the server.
author: Cockpit
